no-restricted-syntax.message: No inline style in the marketing system. box-shadow, arbitrary radius, hex and off-scale spacing all hide behind style={{}}. Use colour tokens + the type/spacing scale + utility classes (CATALOGO_SISTEMA.md §1).
No arbitrary Tailwind values (mt-[37px], w-[203px], text-[#fff], aspect-[4/3]). Use the 4·8·12·16·24·32·48·64·96·128 scale or a token utility (.ratio-4x3, .corner-cut).
No arbitrary Tailwind values inside a template string. Same rule as above.
No hex colours in code. Use a token: ink, ink-2, rule, rule-light, paper, paper-2, muted, muted-dark, signal.
No hex colours in code. Use a colour token.
No shadows or rings anywhere (CATALOGO §1.3). Elevation is a surface change plus a 1px hairline.
One radius token only: `rounded` = 4px. `rounded-full` is allowed solely on the /about avatar (CATALOGO §1.3).
Borders are always 1px. Hierarchy comes from border colour, not width (CATALOGO §1.3).
